findings.title: Per-sync reflect.DeepEqual on a 42-string calendar struct
findings.message: CalendarCell is now attached to every day cell, including disabled ones, and the ValidateControl change allows disabled cells with an empty ID. In driver.go the layout invalidation uses reflect.DeepEqual on the CalendarCell pointer contents, which embeds a [42]string array, on every sync of every node. This is a per-node deep comparison on every sync, adding cost for each of 42 cells.
findings.suggestion: Compare only the fields that affect layout (for example Selected) instead of using reflect.DeepEqual on the whole struct, and guard the comparison to n.CalendarCell != nil.
findings.evidence: cell.CalendarCell = &CalendarCell{IDs: ids, Index: i, Selected: selected}

finding.title: reflect.DeepEqual in hot sync path
finding.message: reflect.DeepEqual runs for every node on every sync, even those that have no calendar cell. Other nodes pay the reflection call cost on every update. Also, a selection change toggles the style via layout invalidation only; the appearance update relies on Update() being triggered.
finding.suggestion: Short-circuit: only call DeepEqual when either pointer is non-nil, or compare Selected/Index directly.
